nom: NOTO Botanics Safe Sun SPF 30 Invisible Serum Sunscreen

avis.texte: I love everything NOTO makes but dang this is amazing. After using it my skin looks so glowly and healthy I dont even need to wear much makeup. Also it works. My skin has stayed hydrated and bright. Smells so nice too - i love the ingredients so much !
I love this spf acts like a moisturizer, doesn't pill, and doesn't leave a white cast. It's super lightweight and I will be rebuying!
I purchased it for my sunscreen-hating boyfriend. He actually uses this product and loves the smell and how non-greasy the formula is.
The first time I applied this product to my face there was an immediate wonderful moist look to my skin. It was rather startling. I'm buying this for my daughters.
This sunscreen is great! It's goes on well and it not too thick and/or greasy, absorbing well with no noticeable scent. Highly recommend!

This is my 3rd bottle of the Safe Sun serum and I love this product so much. Doesn't leave my skin oily at all and leaves my skin feeling hydrated. I genuinely believe the niacinamides have helped the overall quality of my skin!
